findings.title: Punishment as a bounded body-sign
findings.claim: Within the declared pericope, the command to cut the thieves' hands reads as a specified bodily and deterrent consequence whose visible form marks a bounded response.
findings.mechanism: The focus's cutting, hands, recompense, and deterrent noun contact the nearby 5:31 and 5:33 examples of modeled, bodily, and territorial consequences; crucifixion, crosswise hand-and-foot cutting, and exile make the focus's hands-only operation legible as one configured response.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the literal hands and cutting as a publicly intelligible, bounded consequence, with the altered body or removed place functioning as a warning addressed beyond the immediate offender.
findings.containment: The comparison leaves the focus's bodily referent intact. It does not equate the offenses, impose a universal legal scale, or turn the local image into a surah-wide system.

epistemic.reason: The supplied channel evidence and exact nearby forms ground a local contextual resonance, while the channel remains a nomination rather than an adjudicated recurring system.

findings.containment: The literal hand remains the focus referent, and the agency reading is an attributed contextual inference from the reconstructed HFT trace. friction_notes: Phase 2 reviewed the explicitly added external ayat 1:2-1:7 individually. Their praise, mercy, judgment, worship, guidance, and path material supplies no local carrier-trigger-contact that changes 5:38 beyond the native pericope; importing a whole-Fatiha theme would therefore be an excluded overlay.

All focus word alignments are resolved. Available focus branches without a supplied candidate or independent activating contact were treated as availability only, and no additional uncandidate macro activation survived the carrier, trigger, changed-reading, payoff, and boundary tests.

The three HFT records are reconstructed and legacy_unbound, with target morphology absent. They remain visible as qualified attributed evidence; unresolved branches carry null glosses and facets rather than invented lexical content.

Live counter-readings remain contained: 5:28 may be read as a literal hand scene without functional agency, 5:33 may comprise independent rules rather than one scale, and 5:39 may change divine standing without cancelling the focus consequence.
